`constitution-17.json` is a real answer of Ordo's `MatsneAPI().get_article("17", law="constitution")`
(github.com/sitechfromgeorgia/ordo-mcp, MIT, commit 1ab4463), fetched live from matsne.gov.ge on 2026-11-02: the
official text of article 17 of the Constitution of Georgia (document 30346, publication 36 of 29/06/2020).

Licence: none needed. Copyright does not extend to official documents such as laws (Law of Georgia on Copyright and
Neighbouring Rights, article 8, part 1 a: „საავტორო უფლება არ ვრცელდება ... ოფიციალურ დოკუმენტებზე (კანონები, ...)“,
matsne.gov.ge document 16198). Source to credit: matsne.gov.ge (the Legislative Herald of Georgia).
